topic: DOOH data filtering and versioning strategy
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered two main data tasks. First, a request was made to set up server access for DOOH-267, specifically requiring filtering by city using the existing facility dictionary. The speaker confirmed this setup is needed and suggested creating a separate parameter collector in the controller for campaigns since it is passed via POST.

Second, regarding `frame_va`, the consensus was reached on adding an integer version field and linking it to the existing versions table. This approach was deemed simpler than creating entirely new tables or fields.
decisions: Server access for DOOH-267 is required with city filtering using the facility dictionary.
A separate parameter collector must be created in the controller for campaigns due to POST data handling.
For `frame_va`, an integer version field will be added, linked to the existing versions table.
action_items: [p1] to implement both the DOOH-267 filtering and the frame_va versioning updates.
